description: This Kotlin source file defines the PostPlaybackRatingActivity class, which manages a post-playback rating screen in an Android app. It handles displaying a rating prompt after video playback, manages countdown timers, user interactions, and navigation back to playback. The file interacts with a Repository for data operations and uses Android UI components to present and collect user feedback.

classes.name: PostPlaybackRatingActivity
classes.description: Android Activity displaying a post-playback rating prompt, handling user input and lifecycle events.

methods.name: clampDisplayTime
methods.description: Ensures display time does not exceed 60 seconds, defaulting if zero or negative.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, checks conditions to show or skip the rating screen, sets up countdown and event handlers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the countdown timer upon activity destruction.

methods.name: onRate
methods.description: Records user rating and navigates back to playback.

methods.name: startCountdown
methods.description: Starts a countdown timer, updating a TextView, and triggers a callback on finish.

methods.name: finishToPlayback
methods.description: Launches the PlaybackActivity with the given content ID and finishes the current activity.
